style: Energetic, well-organised side that blends Lusophone technical comfort with athletic intensity. Compact defensively and dangerous in transition, drawing largely on a Portugal- and Europe-based diaspora.
recent_form: Sensational debut qualification under coach Bubista, topping CAF Group D with 23 points and only one defeat, finishing ahead of Cameroon. Earned a creditable draw with Spain in their World Cup opener before facing Uruguay and Saudi Arabia in Group H.

key_players.name: Vozinha
key_players.note: Standout league performer this season and a reliable last line for the islanders.

key_players.name: Diney Borges
key_players.note: One of the team's strongest performers by club form; contributes energy and quality in midfield.

key_players.name: Sidny Lopes Cabral
key_players.note: Highly rated this season; adds technical control and progression to the side.

historical_news: Qualified for their first-ever FIFA World Cup, an island nation of just over 500,000 people.
Topped CAF Group D ahead of continental giant Cameroon to secure automatic qualification under Bubista.
Held Spain to a draw in their World Cup debut match, a landmark result for the Blue Sharks.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Widely framed as a feel-good fairytale; their qualification over Cameroon and a debut draw with Spain drew global praise for one of the smallest nations ever to reach the finals.
